corrections.corrected_statement: A learner permit holder may drive only with a licensed adult at least twenty one years old or a sibling at least eighteen years old.
corrections.note: Removed licensed from sibling because the page requires it only for the adult.

corrections.corrected_statement: An intermediate license holder may not drive between eleven at night and five in the morning unless accompanied by a licensed adult at least twenty one years old or a sibling at least eighteen years old.
corrections.note: Removed licensed from sibling because the page requires it only for the adult.

corrections.corrected_statement: The guide contrasts exit-only access with other roads that permit street or driveway connections.
Total stopping distance includes perception, reaction and braking distances.
corrections.note: The definition is printed on page 69, not page 70.

corrections.corrected_statement: Do not pass a vehicle stopped at a crosswalk because it may hide a crossing pedestrian.
Correct the address on your vehicle registration within ten days after you move.
corrections.note: Added the ten day deadline required by law.

corrections.corrected_statement: Contact your local Office of Motor Vehicles or visit the website for specific fee information on commercial vehicles, motorcycles, special license plates, license plate transfers and similar items.
corrections.note: Narrowed the advice to the specific fee types listed on the page.

corrections.corrected_statement: Wind, rain or ice can make a bicyclist less stable, so reduce speed and leave extra space.
corrections.note: Stability and extra space wording is on page 86, not page 85.

corrections.corrected_statement: A motorcycle can be missed in a quick glance or hidden in another vehicle’s blind spot.
corrections.note: Full sentence starts on page 86, not page 87.
